Hi Samir —

Congrats — looks like your account just crossed the automated usage trigger we watch for. We see a concentrated spike from a handful of long-running sessions (nice work). To make sure you don’t get surprised on cost or tail latency, I wanted to offer a short 30-minute runbook session where we can:  

- Walk through the runbook for spikes (KV cache, batching, and graceful fallback)
- Look at the token unit economics from the last 48–72 hours
- Surface a couple quick config suggestions you can flip on right away

I can do a focused hands-on call (not a sales deck) — 30 minutes. Attached is a 1-page agenda. Proposed slots:

- Tue Dec 6, 11:00 AM PT / 2:00 PM ET
- Tue Dec 6, 4:00 PM PT / 7:00 PM ET
- Wed Dec 7, 9:00 AM PT / 12:00 PM ET

If none of those work, tell me a couple 30-minute windows that do and I’ll coordinate. I’m looping in Marissa (AE) and Ben (Customer Ops) so we can scope any follow-ups.

Attachments: runbook-agenda.pdf (1 page)

Thanks —
Lauren Bishop
Sales Development Rep, Redwood Inference
